notes.title: Patch 1.8 Notes (Now Live)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.8 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot Steam.

[u]Patch 1.8 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]The pre-order contest winner cameo has (finally) been added to the game.
[*]A new achievement has been added for finding the contest winner.
[*]The death screens can now be skipped by pressing a button.
[*]The glitch transition effect has been slightly reworked for increased performance.
[*]One of the Knights in Assholevania decided to destroy a block that was confusing some players
[*]The monsters in Dungeons and Dickholes have built a small platform before the first set of disappearing blocks.
[/list]

If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/540732889731160340/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1 Notes (Now Live)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.7.1 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.7.1 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Keyboard mapping has been re-worked for improved functionality
[*]When using a Keyboard. the arrow and enter keys will always be used to navigate the menu. This will allow the menus to be navigated regardless of what key-bindings have been set to.
[*]Fixed a bug where that would cause players to continue with 0 lives after quitting at the game over screen. 
[*]The game will no longer detect keyboard inputs when windowed or tabbed out.
[/list]

If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/792924952554190955/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: AVGNA Halloween Event!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween everyone! To celebrate the spookiest of holidays we've added a fun skin change to the characters. In addition, beating the final boss on normal or higher difficulty will unlock a special achievement. The achievement and skin will only be available through Sunday November 3rd. So make sure you pay the final boss a visit before then!

Also in this update
[list]
[*]Keyboard mapping can now be reset before launching the game. To do this type “/keyreset” in the game’s Launch Options in Steam.
[*]Fixed a few minor graphical glitches.
[/list] 

To ensure the update applies, please close and relaunch Steam.Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.7 Notes (Now Live)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.7 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.7 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Keyboard mapping has been added and can be found in the options menu.
[*]Users can now disable gamepad detection. To do this type “/gamepadoff” in the game’s Launch Options in Steam
[*]Fixed a bug where the Window would periodically reset it’s position to the middle of the screen if the user had moved it
[*]You can no longer get stuck in the re-appearing blocks in Boo! Haunted House
[*]Time now maxes out at 999 minutes in the options menu
[*]Beer, Deaths and 1ups collected now max out at 9999 in the options menu
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the game from returning to the main menu after completing the game
[/list]
For a list of other things that we're working on please visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846965056827666023/]Upcoming Features Thread[/url]. If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/792923683654130168/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.6 Notes [Now Live]
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.6 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.6 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Intro logos can now be skipped by pressing a button
[*]A volume control feature has been added to the options menu
[*]A music volume control has been added to the options menu
[*]The game no longer polls for Xbox 360 controllers at every loop. This should fix lag when using a 360 controller that some users were experiencing
[*]Cheat codes can now be entered with a Keyboard. Use the arrows and the keys L, R, A, B, X and Y 
[*]Fixed a bug in the "Fucking Impossible" difficulty that cause a player to lose two lives when dying at certain bosses
 [*]Fixed a bug that would cause Guitar Guys projectile to "stick" on screen
[*]Players will no longer see a dialog box pop up briefly before the boss on Beat it & Eat It
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow the final boss to double hit on collision
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow some players to get "stuck" in the moving cog platforms in the final level.
[/list]
For a list of other things that we're working on please visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846965056827666023/]Upcoming Features Thread[/url]. If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846966336139303766/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.5 Patch Notes [Now Live]
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.5 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.5 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug that would sometimes allow bullets to pass through "Bob the Robot" enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug in Dungeons and Dickholes that would cause players to get stuck in the bridge if a disappearing block appeared on top of them.
[*][u]Added Multiple Video modes to the Options menu[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Full[/b] - Default recommended mode that displays the game at full screen.
[*][b]Compatibility Mode[/b] - Displays at full screen, but with a fix for users that experience an issue where the screen is displayed in a small window in the corner of the screen.
[*][b]Window[/b] - Displays the game in a 960x540 window.
[*][b]Window (Medium)[/b] - Displays the game in a 640x360 window.
[*][b]Window (Small)[/b] - Displays the game in a 320x180 window
[/list]
[*]Pressing the Esc key when in Full Mode will automatically switch the game to Window Mode and can be done at any time.
[/LIST]
For a list of other things that we're working on please visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846965056827666023/]Upcoming Features Thread[/url]. If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!
